posts.title: How to evaluate a nonprofit software discount
posts.summary: A short checklist before you apply for a vendor nonprofit plan.
posts.html:
Before you apply:

  1. Confirm your organization type (often 501(c)(3) or country equivalent).

  2. Prefer direct vendor portals that accept an EIN or determination letter when you want to skip intermediary tokens.

  3. Capture the offer details (seats, credits, renewal) and a verification date — discounts drift.

  4. Cross-check AlternativeTo for free and open substitutes.

  5. Record who in your org owns renewals and compliance.

We will expand this guide as the catalog grows.
